name: Landmine Princess
source:
Meet Mina! She's a landmine girl! That means she's cute on the outside, but dangerous on the inside! But maybe she's the kind of danger you've always been looking for. This is a rogue fast-love dating sim. And the only sim that teaches you to be nice to girls. Or else.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3263330/Landmine_Princess/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
认识米娜！她是一个地雷女孩！也就是说，她外表可爱，但内心却很危险！但也许她就是你一直在寻找的那种危险。这是一款流氓速恋约会模拟游戏。也是唯一能教你善待女孩的模拟游戏。否则。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3263330/Landmine_Princess/]Steam[/url]]
